desc: Alloy receiver, matte blued finish, tapered bull barrel, overmolded ambidextrous grips blowback action, single-action trigger, Pro-Target adjustable sights. Most distinctively, they have our overmolded Ultragrip FX ambidextrous grips, which are both comfortable and ensure a positive grip on the pistol, whether you're shooting in wet conditions or your young learning shooter needs a better grip with their smaller hands. Caliber: 22 LR; Barrel Length: 5 1/2"; Barrel Finish: Matte Blued; Receiver Finish: Matte Black; Sights: Pro Target; Receiver Material: Aluminum Alloy; Magazine Capacity: 10 rnd.
